question.text: At 300 <math><mi mathvariant="normal">k</mi></math> the half‐life a sample of a gaseous compound initially at 1 atm is 100 sec. When the pressure is 0.5 atm the half‐life is 50 sec. The order of reaction is

solution.text:
For a zero order reaciton, t 1/2 ∝initial concentration
⇒ t 1/2 ∝pressure
Since, half life decreases to half with similar decrease in pressure. Hence, the order of reaction is zero.
